Isaiah 60v5 GNB

You will see this and be filled with joy; You will tremble with excitement. The wealth of the nations will be brought to you; From across the sea their riches will come.?Wealth, yes, wealth in all its entirety is coming your way this new year.. ✔You will see it wherever it is.✔Your heart will be gladdened by what you will see and possess this year.?✔ The strategies, the connections, the resources you need to make wealth this year will be provided for by God in Jesus name??
